surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed.
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the published effective diameter; these are not three independently measured axes.
radiusMeaning: Volume-equivalent radius of the chosen illustrative equal-axis model, not a measured 3D-volume radius.
name: Sedna
periodText: About 10.3 hours from photometry; aliases and a possible doubled shape period remain unresolved.
credit: Pál et al. (2012), Herschel/PACS thermophysical analysis; Gaudi et al. (2005), rotational photometry.
shapeMeaning: Size-constrained spherical illustration at the 995 ±80 km thermal diameter. Herschel constrains effective size, not three axes; no resolved global shape or topography is represented.
introduction: Sedna follows an exceptionally distant, elongated orbit beyond the planetary region. This grid-covered illustration conveys its thermal size estimate; its actual shape and surface terrain remain unresolved.
